allow:
Bash(.specify/scripts/powershell/create-new-feature.ps1 -Json "/sp.specify Todo Web Application Backend API

Target audience:
- Hackathon evaluators reviewing backend correctness
- Developers implementing API-first architectures
- Engineers validating spec-driven backend systems

Focus:
- REST API for Todo task management
- Persistent storage using Neon PostgreSQL
- Clean separation between API logic and data layer
- Backend prepared for multi-user isolation

Success criteria:
- Implements all required Todo CRUD endpoints
- Tasks are persisted and retrievable from NeonDB
- Each task is associated with a user_id
- API responses are predictable and consistent
- Backend operates independently of frontend logic

Constraints:
- Framework: FastAPI
- ORM: SQLModel
- Database: Neon Serverless PostgreSQL
- API format: JSON only
- Environment-based configuration
- No frontend dependencies
- No authentication logic in this spec

Not building:
- Authentication or authorization logic
- Frontend UI
- Real-time updates
- Background jobs
- Caching layers" --json --number 1 --short-name "todo-backend-api" "Todo Web Application Backend API")

Bash(pwsh -File ".specify/scripts/powershell/create-new-feature.ps1" -Json -ShortName "auth-layer" -Number 1 "/sp.specify Todo Web Application Authentication Layer

Target audience:
- Hackathon evaluators testing security guarantees
- Developers implementing JWT-based auth
- Engineers reviewing stateless authorization systems

Focus:
- Secure authentication across decoupled frontend and backend
- JWT issuance by frontend and verification by backend
- Enforcement of user isolation at API level

Success criteria:
- JWT token issued on successful sign-in
- JWT token included in all API requests
- Backend validates token signature and expiry
- Backend extracts authenticated user identity
- Task queries filtered by authenticated user
- Cross-user access attempts are rejected

Constraints:
- JWT-based authentication only
- Shared secret via environment variables
- Authorization via HTTP Bearer tokens
- No reliance on frontend sessions

Not building:
- OAuth providers
- Refresh token rotation
- Role-based access control
- Password recovery flows
- Email verification")
